executive_summary.text: MASONICARE HEALTH CENTER (075135): Operational / Managerial Control from 1995-10-01 to present; staffing during this period averaged 3.9 total nurse HPRD over 34 quarters.

MASONICARE AT BISHOP WICKE HEALTH AND REHABILITATION CENTER, INC. (075163): Operational / Managerial Control from 2024-12-31 to present; staffing during this period averaged 4.5 total nurse HPRD over 6 quarters.
In cost year 2025, homes linked to this company reported $2,946,004 in management fees on DSS cost reports.
